exposure: Treatment modalities for Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM): diet
outcome: Neonatal intensive care unit admissions >24 hrs
cohort: The study included women diagnosed with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) who delivered between January 2019 and March 2020 at a peri-urban teaching hospital.
finding: Good glycaemic control was achieved in diet and metformin groups, while insulin-required groups showed a higher incidence of gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, lower Apgar scores, increased neonatal intensive care unit admissions, and neonatal hypoglycaemia.
mod_finding: No difference was noted with respect to induction labour and caesarean delivery rates between the GDM treatment groups.
followup_time: Up to delivery and immediate neonatal period (within 1 week for early neonatal death)
